content.title: Inside Arvada Podcast
content.summary: Inside Arvada is the official podcast of the City of Arvada, featuring discussions with city team members about the community's past, present, and future, as well as topics like parks, sustainability, and transportation. The podcast is accessible on various platforms, including Apple, Spotify, Amazon Music, and YouTube, and transcripts are available online. The hosts, Katie Patterson and Sean Star, bring backgrounds in communications and public engagement to their roles in informing the community about local initiatives.
content.body:
![](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=3559)Inside Arvada is the City of Arvada’s official podcast where we bring you conversations with the people who make Arvada a thriving community. Hear stories about the past, present and future of Arvada through the lens of the City team members who help make it all happen. Explore the complex topics impacting our community and dig in to conversations about parks and sustainability, development, transportation, water resources and more.

## How to listen to the Inside Arvada podcast

Inside Arvada is available wherever you listen to podcasts. Simply search "Inside Arvada" to find the show on your preferred podcast platform. You can also use the icons below to listen on Apple, Spotify, Amazon Music or YouTube. The podcast can also be streamed using the embedded web player on this page.

### Transcripts Available

Some podcast platforms provide a transcript of the episode in the app. [Transcripts are also available online](https://insidearvada.buzzsprout.com/). Click into the individual episode to access the transcript.

## Meet our hosts

### Katie Patterson

![headshot of Katie Patterson](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=3472)

Katie joined the City of Arvada team in 2022 as the Infrastructure Communications Manager. She works with the Public Works and Utilities Departments to provide community members with timely and relevant information about infrastructure projects and programs. This includes topics like transportation, water, recycling and trash services and much more. Prior to working for the City, Katie worked in community engagement and project management for Denver Public Schools. Katie completed her bachelor's and master's in communication studies with a focus on public engagement at Colorado State University. Go Rams!

### Sean Star

![Sean Star ](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=3527)Sean joined the City of Arvada team in 2022 as the Communications Manager for the City's Vibrant Community and Neighborhoods work system. He provides communications support for Sustainability, Parks, Park Maintenance, Parks and Urban Design, Golf and Restaurants, Festivals, Arts and Culture, and the Majestic View Nature Center. Prior to working for the City, Sean worked in public affairs at Jefferson County, was the Director of Sports Information at Johnson & Wales University in Denver and was previously a multimedia journalist. Born and raised in Frisco, Colorado, Sean graduated from Colorado State University with degree in Technical Journalism. Go Rams! (sorry CU fans).
